## Launch Date

The foldable iPhone, the iPhone 18 Pro, and the iPhone 18 Pro Max will debut in September 2026. All three could launch in September, but there have recently been rumors suggesting the iPhone Fold will be introduced in September and will launch in December, so we could potentially get the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max in September and the iPhone Fold a bit later.

The iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and a second-generation iPhone Air are expected to follow in spring 2027. [...] Apple is deviating from its standard iPhone launch timeline in 2026 and 2027.
